title: Partial normalized diagonal trace presentation
statement: For a prime l, a finite l-adic coefficient field E, a morphism f:X→S, and the recorded localizations, define PartialPresentation by retaining every Presentation field except the two final Milnor invertibility proofs.

source.place: paragraph (1), geometric, coefficient, and derived comparison data before the Milnor step

proof.text: This is a packaging definition: its fields are exactly the corresponding fields of Presentation, with no proof data hidden in the definition.
